$doc: THE EFFECTS LIBRARY (Mike, 2026-10-25: 'they are just effects, regardless of sound or not'). An EFFECT = a DEVICE = one MOTION recipe + the SOUND(s) that fire with it + the GRAPHICS it needs (texture, icon, button), grabbed as a unit; never the motion silent, never the sound on a static card, one sound per event. Devices are grouped into THEMES: a theme is the set of devices + palette + textures + sounds that belong to one look, and a VIDEO (or a CHAPTER of a longer video) picks ONE theme and declares which of its devices it uses in the SCREENPLAY [SHOW] lines (device id + sound id). Icons and similar flourishes are a per-video choice inside the theme, never added to every video by default. The SOUND FILES stay in the SFX catalog (video-creation/assets/sfx/, one row per file, picked by id); this library references them by id. The MOTION engines are Remotion code in video-creation/remotion/src/effects/<theme>/ (shared infra, import-whitelisted like ./transitions/*); the longform-edited placement rules (layer order, captions off under a pop, overlay vs transition) are video-creation/longform-edited/skills/overlays/overlays.md section 2. Skill + check tool: video-creation/skills/effects-library/effects-library.md (effects_catalog.py check = every device's sounds exist in the SFX catalog, every graphic exists on disk, every engine file exists). Themes live in themes/<theme>/ (CUE-SHEET.md = the time-ordered map of the source video, textures/, graphics/).
$schema_note: `devices` keyed by device id (kt-* = the 2023 kinetic-text theme). Row: name - trigger (the on-screen EVENT, the field to pick by) - motion {sub-steps with 1080p px / percent-of-frame / seconds / easing} - text_look_2023 or look_2023 (the SOURCE look; a house video keeps motion + sound and uses the house font + chapter accent) - assets {role: path under this folder} - sound [{id (an SFX catalog id), when (offset to the motion)}] or sound_by_meaning - reference_cues_main_sequence (seconds in the theme's source video) - used_in (frozen history; live usage = the usage ledger). `themes` keyed by theme id: source - look - devices (the ids) - sfx_folder.
